subject: Arden Health MAP: network gating, org setup, API keys & peering cadence
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@ardenhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and questions about network gating

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Arden is excited to move forward with a 6-week POC, but our security team needs a clear gating checklist up front so we can plan procurement & networking. Two immediate asks:

1) We need to understand the sequence and owner for: org setup (admin invites), API key provisioning, IP allowlist, and VPC peering.
2) Our infra team needs CIDR and ephemeral port requirements to open tickets.

I'll attach our initial security questionnaire — let me know if you want IT to join a technical call.

Best,
Alex Morgan> Senior Program Manager, Arden Health
attachments: arden_security_q1.pdf

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@ardenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arden MAP request — proposed action plan and dates

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for the questionnaire. I put together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (attached) with owners and a recommended cadence. High-level plan and owners below so your teams can file tickets:

- Week 0 (This week): Executive kickoff + confirm SSO admin. Owner: Rachel (Redwood) / Alex (Arden)
- Week 1: Org creation & admin invites (Redwood console). Owner: Rachel. Deliverable: org admin invites sent, confirmation email.
- Week 2: API key provisioning (sandbox keys) + sample client config. Owner: Rachel + Ben. Deliverable: sandbox API keys and example curl/SDK snippet.
- Week 3: IP allowlist and minimal egress rules — provide CIDR and port list to Arden IT. Owner: Ben. Deliverable: allowlist IPs + ephemeral key rotation notes.
- Week 4: VPC peering trial (optional) or secure tunneling. Owner: Ben + Marissa. Deliverable: peering runbook or VPN endpoint and peering acceptance test.
- Week 5–6: Load test, eval dataset run, success criteria check-in, and close decision. Owner: Marissa + Rachel.

Concrete asks for Arden IT: please open a ticket for IP allowlist and (if you prefer peering) a VPC peering request with the contact for the network engineer and preferred maintenance window.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (MAP with dates), network_airgap_diagram.png (sample peering diagram).

I recommended the following tentative dates: org invites on 2028-05-18, sandbox keys on 2028-05-25, allowlist on 2028-06-01, peering trial 2028-06-08. We can accelerate if your IT is ready.

Next step: 30-min technical kickoff Wednesday 2028-05-17 at 10:00 PT. Can you confirm?

—Rachel
Rachel Kim | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@ardenhealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arden MAP: network gating, org setup, API keys & peering cadence

Alex / Rachel — looping in some technical detail so IT can start drafting tickets. Quoting Rachel's schedule above.

Quick tech notes:
- IPs for sandbox endpoints (static egress): 34.198.12.5, 34.198.12.6 (these are our controlled egress NATs for the sandbox; production endpoints will be different and assigned per-region).
- Ports: 443 outbound TCP. For peering health checks we use TCP 443 and ICMP ping in the acceptance phase.
- VPC peering requirements: allow route exchange for 10.0.0.0/24 (Arden test CIDR) <-> 172.31.10.0/24 (Redwood peering CIDR). We do not require transit gateway; simple VPC peering is sufficient for POC.
- DNS: If you plan to use internal DNS names, we'll provide conditional forwarder instructions; otherwise use public endpoints with allowlist.
- API keys: we'll create sandbox keys scoped to the org and tag them with "arden-poc-2028". Keys rotate via our console; we recommend rotation every 30 days during the POC.

Sample curl (sandbox key placeholder):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-sandbox-ARDN-EXAMPLE" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://sandbox.api.redwood.com/v1/generate

I'll be available on the tech kickoff. If your network team prefers a Terraform peer resource, I can share a quick snippet after we confirm the exact CIDRs.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: IT Ops <itops@ardenhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@ardenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arden MAP: network gating, org setup, API keys & peering cadence

Thanks — this is helpful.

Quick answers from Arden IT:
- We will open a ticket for the IP allowlist with the SAN:INC maint window of 2028-06-01 02:00–04:00 PT.
- Primary network contact: Jordan Li (jordan@ardenhealth.com).
- Our test VPC CIDR for the POC: 10.2.0.0/24.

Please send the peering JSON or Terraform snippet and the exact NAT egress addresses for our firewall team to validate. We'll aim to complete the allowlist and the peering request by 2028-06-03.

—Arden IT (IT Ops)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@ardenhealth.com>, IT Ops <itops@ardenhealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arden MAP: network gating, org setup, API keys & peering cadence

Alex / Jordan / team — closing the loop after our internal follow-ups and the tech kickoff. Summary & firmed dates:

- 2028-05-18: Redwood to send org admin invites — DONE.
- 2028-05-25: Sandbox API keys issued to Arden org (tag: arden-poc-2028) — DONE. Chunked keys for two dev users included.
- 2028-06-01 02:00–04:00 PT: IP allowlist change window (Arden ticket in progress).
- 2028-06-04: VPC peering acceptance test (provisional, moved to allow for firewall review).
- 2028-06-10: Baseline eval run and smoke tests against sample dataset. Success criteria: 95th p90 latency under 500ms for short prompts; embedding throughput meets 80% target.

Action items:
- Jordan (Arden): confirm test VPC route 10.2.0.0/24 is available for peering and provide the peering request ticket ID once filed.
- Ben (Redwood): share Terraform snippet + final NAT egress addresses.
- Alex / Rachel: schedule check-in 2028-06-11 to review eval metrics and decide on expansion.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (finalized MAP).

Thanks — we'll stand by to assist with any firewall exceptions or quick-turn config changes.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
